baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَيَّدتُّكَ, عَلَّمْتُكَ, the four بِإِذْنِى clauses, and كَفَفْتُ
baseline_models.mechanism: First-person acts supply support, knowledge, and protection; second-person verbs retain Jesus as the proximate actor; repeated permission gates the extraordinary effects. The grammar therefore layers agency instead of collapsing it into either autonomy or passivity.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening supplies the endowed capacity from which the later acts proceed.
Disclosure to a knower makes taught knowledge another received capacity.
Authorization or licensing repeatedly gates the transition from capacity to effect.
Restraint supplies a protective divine action that the human agent does not perform.

changed_reading.before: A catalogue of miracles performed by Jesus.
changed_reading.after: A provenance ledger that preserves Jesus's real proximate action while assigning capacity, authorization, effect, and protection to distinct levels of divine agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ, تُكَلِّمُ, تَنفُخُ, فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًا, and تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَى
baseline_models.mechanism: Spirit-supported life enables intelligible speech; sent breath enters formed matter; the form becomes a flying creature; life is finally drawn out from death. These are not merely adjacent wonders but an ascending current from animation of voice to animation of matter to recovery from death.

activation_trace.role: Spirit as the life of the body supplies the animating source of the sequence.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers is the first outward sign of animated capacity.
Sending wind into something supplies the explicit pneumatic transfer.
Coming to occurrence marks the realized state after the breath enters.
Bringing something out of concealment makes restored life an emergence.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal condition that the sequence reverses.

changed_reading.before: Speech, a clay bird, and the dead are three unrelated marvels.
changed_reading.after: They form a graded life-and-expression sequence: supported voice, breathed animation, then emergence from death, all under authorization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ ... تَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause separates measured design, raw material, visible configuration, pneumatic input, and realized mobility. Permission appears at the conversion points, so the account foregrounds an articulated making process rather than an undifferentiated marvel.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the design operation.
Mixed clay supplies the passive material substrate.
Outward configuration supplies resemblance before actual animation.
Breath sent into the configured matter supplies the activating input.
Occurrence in time marks the actualized result rather than mere resemblance.
Light flight distinguishes the living result from its earlier bird-shaped model.
Permission licenses both the making and the transition into the realized creature.

changed_reading.before: Clay is instantly changed into a bird.
changed_reading.after: A staged material process moves from measured form through breath to realized mobility, while authorization marks where resemblance crosses into life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ, تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَى, ٱلْبَيِّنَات, كَفَرُوا, and سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs reverse blindness, disorientation, conspicuous bodily marking, and death-as-concealment. The audience then answers disclosure with a counter-operation: covering the truth and relabeling manifest evidence as deceptive diversion. The ending tests reception, not merely spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Recovery from illness supplies bodily restoration.
Directionless confusion extends the blindness image into failed orientation.
A visibly contrasting white mark supplies the conspicuous defect that is removed.
Extraction from concealment renders the dead's return as disclosure.
Appearance and uncovering characterize both the signs and the accusation's claim to obviousness.
Veiling the truth supplies the audience's counter-action against disclosure.
Diversion and deception supply the rival causal label imposed on the signs.

changed_reading.before: Healing and resurrection are followed by an irrational accusation of magic.
changed_reading.after: Restorations repeatedly expose what was blocked or hidden, while disbelief actively re-covers that exposure by assigning it a deceptive cause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى followed by the repeated إِذْ units and the final reported response
baseline_models.mechanism: The command to retrieve a preserved benefaction organizes dispersed life episodes into a bounded account. Cradle, maturity, teaching, making, healing, raising, protection, and reception are recalled as entries whose sequence matters.

activation_trace.role: Retrieval after possible absence from attention supplies the organizing act.
Good condition and benefaction supply the ledger's governing category.
The prepared cradle fixes the account's earliest life-stage marker.
Completed age supplies the distant endpoint paired with infancy.
Uttered speech frames both the divine recital and the audience's recorded answer.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises Jesus by listing memorable gifts.
changed_reading.after: The imperative reconstructs an ordered account of received capacities, authorized acts, protection, and public reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding legal sequence distinguishes what is available from what is permitted and names transgression as crossing a limit. Against that matrix, the four permission clauses operate as boundary gates: exceptional capacity becomes a licit effect only through authorization.

activation_trace.role: Licensing supplies the repeated gate on making, animation, healing, and emergence.
Prohibition supplies the closed side of the pericope's boundary system.
Dissolution of a restriction supplies the opened side of that system.
Crossing a limit identifies capacity exercised outside its authorized bound.

structural_cues: 5:87-97 repeatedly alternate lawful access, prohibition, sacred restriction, and reachable objects.
5:110 places بِإِذْنِى at four extraordinary effects rather than stating authorization only once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a permission/prohibition matrix and repeated licensing; I infer that authorization functions as an operative causal-legal gate; the live alternative is that بِإِذْنِى is only emphatic attribution.

changed_reading.before: By My permission is a repeated theological qualification.
changed_reading.after: It is the boundary operator that converts available extraordinary power into authorized action without permitting transgressive autonomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rules for testimony and its correction lead directly to the day messengers are assembled and asked how they were answered. The next divine speech in 5:110 then reads as an evidentiary recital: provenance, authorized acts, signs presented, protection supplied, and the audience's answer are all entered into the record.

activation_trace.role: Retrieval of a preserved matter becomes the focus verse's record-reconstruction command.
Uttered speech records both the examiner's recital and the respondents' accusation.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies the immediately preceding evidentiary procedure.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the assembled hearing.
Messengers and message identify those whose reception is under review.
A returned answer supplies the hearing's explicit question of reception.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 regulate witness claims, replacement testimony, and the fear that oaths may be returned.
5:109 assembles the messengers and asks about their reception; 5:110 immediately opens with God's address to Jesus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness procedure, an assembled questioning, and immediate direct discourse; I infer that adjacency carries a forensic frame into 5:110; the live alternative is a commemorative recital without juridical force.

changed_reading.before: Jesus is privately told to remember a sequence of blessings.
changed_reading.after: God reconstructs before an assembled hearing the provenance of Jesus's acts and the answer his clear signs received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table request explicitly links a tangible sign to heart-settling, verification, and witness, while the warning after its descent links subsequent disbelief to exceptional liability. This sharpens 5:110's ending: clear evidence can ground assurance, but it does not coerce reception, and counter-covering after disclosure is accountable.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering and appearance make the signs available as manifest evidence.
Veiling the truth supplies refusal despite disclosed evidence.
Deceptive diversion supplies the counter-explanation that neutralizes the sign for its rejecters.
Settled assurance supplies one receptive effect sought from a material sign.
Truthful speech supplies the proposition the sign is asked to verify.
Presence with observation supplies the intended move from seeing to bearing witness.
Veiling after the promised sign supplies the culpable failure of reception.
Punitive pain supplies the heightened consequence attached to post-sign refusal.

structural_cues: 5:112-115 moves from requesting a material sign to its epistemic aims and then to liability after reception.
5:110 itself ends not at the wonders but at the audience's rival classification of them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sign-to-assurance-to-witness sequence and a warning against disbelief afterward; I infer that signs increase accountable clarity without forcing assent; the live alternative is that the table warning is episode-specific.

changed_reading.before: The accusation of magic is an incidental hostile reaction.
changed_reading.after: It is the decisive failed-reception event: manifest signs remain resistible, and relabeling them after disclosure turns evidence into heightened responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Spirit support, age-spanning speech, and taught books already form a communication chain in the focus. Context adds the messenger's bounded role, disclosure versus concealment, divine communication to disciples, their testimony, and Jesus's claim that he said only what was commanded. Speech from cradle to maturity is therefore commissioned transmission as well as precocious utterance.

activation_trace.role: Life-giving spirit supplies the enabling support immediately before speech.
Intelligible exchange supplies the public transmission act.
Knowledge disclosed to the recipient supplies communicated content.
Ordered written discourse supplies the textual corpus entrusted for transmission.
Messenger and message supply the bounded office of carrying communication.
Concealment supplies the failed opposite of faithful disclosure.
Divine communication and inspiration supply a downstream transmission to the disciples.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the disciples' requested testimonial endpoint.
Binding command supplies the limit Jesus places on what he communicated.

structural_cues: 5:92 and 5:99 state that the messenger bears delivery while God knows disclosure and concealment.
5:117 has Jesus define his speech by the command he received.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an entrusted communication chain and command-limited speech; I infer that the cradle-to-maturity pairing marks durable commissioned witness; the live alternative is that it marks only miraculous life-stage continuity.

changed_reading.before: Speaking in the cradle is chiefly an age-defying vocal miracle.
changed_reading.after: Speech across the two life stages is a sustained custody of disclosed teaching, whose content and authority remain sourced beyond the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus permits Jesus to bring the dead outward; later God takes Jesus and remains the watcher after his absence; the pericope closes with divine sovereignty and effective capacity over everything. The local reversal of death is thus nested inside an asymmetrical custody of life that remains divine.

activation_trace.role: Bringing out of concealment supplies Jesus's authorized action upon the dead.
Loss of life supplies the condition locally reversed.
Authorization keeps that reversal delegated rather than self-originating.
Taking the soul supplies God's action upon Jesus's own continued presence.
Guarding and watching supply the oversight that remains after Jesus is absent.
Sovereignty supplies the final ownership frame for all delegated acts.
Effective capacity to accomplish supplies the closing source of ultimate power.

structural_cues: 5:110 repeats permission precisely with bringing out the dead.
5:117 contrasts Jesus's finite period of witness with God's continuing watch, and 5:120 closes on universal sovereignty and capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized emergence from death, God's taking of Jesus, continuing divine watch, and final sovereignty; I infer a hierarchy of life custody; the live alternative is that these are successive episodes without a shared agency contrast.

changed_reading.before: Bringing out the dead is one more resurrection wonder.
changed_reading.after: It is a delegated local breach of death nested under the one who can take the delegate, continue watching, and retain universal life-custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names Jesus through Mary and places both under God's favor. The later interrogation asks whether Jesus and his mother were taken as two deities besides God, followed by Jesus's report that he commanded worship of God. The paired-beneficiary grammar now marks both mother and son as recipients, not sources, of extraordinary status.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction and good condition place both named recipients under a prior giver.
The parent defined by birth anchors the explicitly included mother.
The worshipped deity anchors the giver whose favor governs the recital.
The mother as female parent identifies the same paired human relation under interrogation.
Other-than or besides supplies the proposed displacement of divine sourcehood.
Submissive worship supplies Jesus's stated correction of that displacement.

structural_cues: 5:110 says the favor is upon Jesus and upon his mother before recounting Jesus's powers.
5:116 repeats Jesus son of Mary and explicitly pairs him with his mother in the attribution question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired favor, paired naming, and a later paired-deity interrogation; I infer that beneficiary syntax preemptively encodes dependence; the live alternative is that the mother's inclusion expresses maternal honor alone.

changed_reading.before: The favor upon Mary is a collateral family blessing.
changed_reading.after: Naming both mother and son as beneficiaries establishes the recipient/source distinction later tested by the claim that they were deities besides God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the packet's split mapping from context ي د ي to the same mapped ء ي د power branch used by focus أَيَّدتُّكَ. It remains anchored in that exact shared branch and in focus كَفَفْتُ; downstream prose should call it a form-distant power/hand resonance, not a claim that the surface roots are simply identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَيَّدتُّكَ ... وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِى إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنكَ

activation_trace.role: Endowed strength supplies the focus-side capacity.
The packet's secondary power mapping for reachable hands supplies capacity exposed to a limit-test.
Restraint supplies the counterforce that holds hostile capacity away.

changed_reading.before: Divine strengthening and divine protection are separate favors.
changed_reading.after: They form a held-power pair: capacity is endowed, tested by reachable action, and counterbalanced by restraint that prevents hostile power from reaching the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain analogy is surprising because it carries the preparation branch of م ه د beyond the literal cradle and aligns it with the preparation branch of ه ي ء. Both citations remain focus-anchored, but downstream prose should present a possible prepared-substrate pattern, not equate infant development with clay animation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ ... تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ

activation_trace.role: Preparing and leveling an affair turns the cradle into an image of an enabled but ordinarily unready locus.
Intelligible speech supplies the unexpected function realized in the infant locus.
Readiness and preparation supply the shaped clay's pre-activation state.
Mixed clay supplies the ordinarily nonliving substrate.
Flight supplies the unexpected function realized in the material locus.

changed_reading.before: Infant speech and the clay bird are unrelated impossibilities.
changed_reading.after: Both may instantiate a prepared-substrate pattern in which an ordinarily unready locus is configured and enabled to perform its mature or living function.

strongest_changes: The four permission clauses became operative boundary gates within the pericope's larger lawful/forbidden matrix.
The remembrance recital became a forensic provenance-and-reception record after the witness rules and assembled questioning of messengers.
The ending became a theory of resistible signs: disclosure can ground assurance and witness, yet can still be counter-covered and relabeled.
Jesus's speech and life-giving acts became delegated custody chains bounded by command, divine taking, continuing watch, and final sovereignty.
The shared favor upon Jesus and Mary became an explicit recipient/source distinction in light of the later attribution interrogation.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made agency grammar, evidence procedure, sign reception, and later attribution testing converge on one focus verse. The form-distant hand/power split mapping also exposed a contained image of endowed capacity held within restraint.
remaining_uncertainties: How much forensic force belongs to the immediate 5:106-110 sequence rather than to broader eschatological rhetoric.
Whether the pneumatic life-current and prepared-substrate patterns are intended mechanisms or only productive branch resonances.
Whether the table episode supplies a general rule for all signs or a heightened condition specific to that requested sign.
